instrument-sans.credit: Instrument Sans by Rodrigo Fuenzalida and Jordan Egstad (OFL.txt)
instrument-sans.note: Instrument Sans Bold (700) and SemiBold (600) TTF; load with new FontFace(name, `url(${GameAssets.url('fonts/instrument-sans/InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf')})`).

kenney-board-game-icons.note: 255 icons at 64px in 64/, plus a Tilesheet/. Dice faces, cards, arrows, meeples, tokens, stars.

kenney-boardgame.note: PNG cards (fronts and backs), chips, dice (white/red, with borders) and pieces in 7 colours; Spritesheets/ has packed sheets + XML.

kenney-casino-audio.grade_note: Good CC0 pack; late starts trimmed.
kenney-casino-audio.note: Cards (place, slide, shuffle, fan), dice (shake, throw, grab) and chips (stack, collide, handle).

kenney-digital-audio.grade_note: Good CC0 pack; late starts trimmed.
kenney-digital-audio.note: Retro / 8-bit style effects: lasers, power-ups, zaps, phase jumps, tones.

kenney-impact-sounds.grade_note: Good CC0 pack; late starts trimmed.

kenney-interface-sounds.grade_note: Good CC0 pack; late starts trimmed.
kenney-interface-sounds.note: 100 UI sounds: clicks, toggles, confirmations, errors, scrolls.

kenney-music-jingles.grade_note: Good CC0 pack; late starts trimmed.
kenney-music-jingles.note: Short stings for win/lose/level-up in five styles: 8-Bit, Hit, Pizzicato, Sax, Steel.

kenney-ui-audio.grade_note: Good CC0 pack; late starts trimmed.

playing-cards.grade_note: Clear faces. Only the 12 court pictures are drawn by card-table.js; the number cards are drawn in code.
playing-cards.license: CC0 (Zuujis): backs Zuujis SVG; fronts made by Claude (Fable/Opus) for the owner, per the owner (2026-11-23)
playing-cards.note: Standard 52-card fronts (fronts/<suit>_<1-10|jack|queen|king>.png; card-table.js uses the court cards) and six SVG backs.

stick-fighters.note: Three stick fighters (blaze, kai, volt): sheet.png 1600x1320 on white + anim.json (frame rects per move) for the Fight library in game-libs.md. No game uses them yet.

weather-sfx.credit: Ylmir, IgnasD, SketchMan3, rubberduck (OpenGameArt), Freesound CC0
weather-sfx.grade_note: Good loops; 192 kHz files, harmless (browsers resample).
weather-sfx.note: Looping ambience (rain, storm, snow, blizzard, hail, hurricane, dust-storm) + thunder/. See LICENSES.md.

zuujis-2048.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-2048.note: 2048 tile frames, 26x26: t2..t2048, tmax (beyond 2048) and slot. Digits are added at runtime with the bitmap font.

zuujis-arcade.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-arcade.note: 16x16 sprites for the arcade/puzzle games: snake_<green|blue|orange|red>_<mask|head_<arm>|tail_<arm>> (mask = sides joined, n/e/s/w), and more per game (see docs).

zuujis-backgrounds.grade_note: Six soft layered vector scenes (meadow, forest dusk, desert, snow mountains, city night, alien planet), five seamless 1920x1080 layers each, plus eight clouds; scenes.json gives scroll speeds.
zuujis-backgrounds.note: <scene>/1.png (far sky, opaque) .. 5.png (nearest, transparent); every layer tiles left to right. clouds/cloud-N.png. Rebuild: resources/game-art/library-free/backgrounds.

zuujis-board.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-board.note: Board-game art, 42x42 cells: Connect Four c4_cell/c4_red/c4_yellow, Reversi rv_square/rv_black/rv_white, Checkers ck_light/ck_dark/ck_red/ck_black/ck_red_king/ck_black_king (squares are 33-35px inside the cell), and more per game.

zuujis-bricks.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-bricks.note: Brick-breaker art. 20x10 cells: brick_<red|orange|yellow|green|blue> [normal, flash], paddle_<green|blue|orange|red> (16x6, stretch the middle), ball (8x8).

zuujis-characters.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-characters.note: 16x16 characters, frames [walk0, walk1, hurt], facing right. Palette: DawnBringer DB16.

zuujis-flappy.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-flappy.note: Flappy-style art, 40x16 cells: bird (3 wing frames, 16x16), pipe_body (28 wide), pipe_cap (36x16), cloud_a/b, sky_<day|night>_0..4 band tiles (16x16).

zuujis-font.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-font.note: 5x7 bitmap font in 6x8 cells; upper case, digits, punctuation. White glyphs, tinted at draw time. Draw with GameAssets.font().

zuujis-fx.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-fx.note: 16x16 effect strips (play ~12 fps): sparkle, hit, puff, explosion, pulse, heal, flame, splash, star_burst, dust, smoke. Fades use dithering.

zuujis-game-icons.grade_note: 128 clean outlined icons in one style (weapons, armour, potions, food, gems, keys, spells, tools, resources, UI symbols, sci-fi); readable at 32 px.
zuujis-game-icons.note: <name>.png at 128x128; sheet.png is all of them in a 16x8 grid of 128 px cells, sheet.json gives each name its [col, row]. Rebuild: resources/game-art/library-free/icons.

zuujis-items.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-items.note: 16x16 items and icons: coin (4 spin frames), gems, hearts, star, key, potions, food, chests, weapons, gear, resources, and icon_* HUD/UI icons.

zuujis-lantern.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-lantern.note: Last Lantern (survivor-like) art in 32x32 cells, every sprite CENTRED in its cell: warden hero and monsters ghost/zombie/cultist/imp/spider/eye/wisp/shroom/gargoyle [walk0, walk1, hurt] (16px), bosses colossus/lich/wyrm (32px), p_* projectiles (point right), fx_slash/fx_lightning/fx_pool, xp_blue/green/red/gold gems, lantern/oil/hourglass pickups, ic_* level-up icons [plain, gold], props grave/brazier/skulls/crystal/dead_tree/pillar.

zuujis-mahjong.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-mahjong.note: Mahjong tiles in 26x34 cells: mj_man1-9, mj_bam1-9, mj_dot1-9, mj_wind_e/s/w/n, mj_dragon_r/g/w, mj_flower1-4, mj_season1-4, mj_blank, mj_locked.

zuujis-painted-buildings.credit: Zuujis (painted by Codex image generation for From the Ground Up, keyed in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up)
zuujis-painted-buildings.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-buildings.note: Painted isometric buildings on transparent ground, warm storybook style, one picture per building per level: <kind>-<level>.webp (a level without one uses the level below), index.json = lot corners per picture [w,h,xL,yL,xF,yF,xR,yR] for placing on a diamond tile; anim/wind-1-NN.webp = 12-frame turbine (AniCraft).

zuujis-painted-fx.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-fx.note: Painted effect strips, one row of square frames: sparks (10 x 128), smoke (8 x 192), loop-closed (16 x 192).

zuujis-painted-icons.credit: Zuujis (painted by Codex image generation for From the Ground Up, keyed in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up)
zuujis-painted-icons.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-icons.note: 60 painted UI icons, 112 px on transparent, same storybook style as the buildings (air, water, food, energy, play/pause/fast, warnings, seasons, buildings...). Names in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up/ui/ICONS.md.

zuujis-painted-landmarks.credit: Zuujis (painted by Codex image generation for From the Ground Up, keyed in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up)
zuujis-painted-landmarks.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-landmarks.note: Painted landmark buildings: depot (open) and depot_locked; index.json = lot corners.

zuujis-painted-people.credit: Zuujis (painted by Codex image generation for From the Ground Up, keyed in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up)
zuujis-painted-people.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-people.note: Painted townspeople atlases: cast (portraits), walk (toward), away, roll (wheelchair), work poses; index.json = {sheet: {cols, rows, cw, ch, feet}}.

zuujis-painted-props.credit: Zuujis (painted by Codex image generation for From the Ground Up, keyed in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up)
zuujis-painted-props.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-props.note: Painted isometric props: trees and hedges in four seasons (<tree>-<spring|summer|autumn|winter>), vehicles facing toward and away (<name>, <name>-away), street furniture, greenhouse pieces; index.json = ground corners per picture.

zuujis-painted-tower.credit: Zuujis (painted by Codex image generation for From the Ground Up, keyed in resources/game-art/from-the-ground-up)
zuujis-painted-tower.grade_note: Painted storybook art, consistent style, keyed cleanly.
zuujis-painted-tower.note: Painted stackable tower kit: lobby, floor-<kind> (empty, homes, food, energy, water, work, animals, fish, orchard), roof, crane; index.json = how the pieces stack.

zuujis-pixel-effects.grade_note: 48 crisp pixel-art effects (explosions, impacts, lightning, magic, smoke, splatters, sci-fi, elements), 8-16 frames at 15 fps.
zuujis-pixel-effects.note: GameAssets.vfx('<category>/<effect>') -> {draw(ctx, t, x, y)}; index.json lists every effect's frame size and count. Rebuild: resources/game-art/library-free/vfx/make_vfx.py.

zuujis-planes.grade_note: All 24 are ours now: simple low-poly models (about 1.5k triangles, flat colours) with the right silhouettes.
zuujis-planes.license: CC0 1.0 (made for Zuujis): 20 jets by build_jets.py, and the A320, Caravan, F-16 and Spitfire by build_planes.py
zuujis-planes.note: 24 aircraft folders <key>/plane.json (real published specs for GameFlight.register, model settings) + <key>.glb; manifest.json lists them; MODELS_README.md explains the format and the licences.

zuujis-scifi-rts.grade_note: Three factions by ten roles plus 30 icons, drawn in VectorCraft.
zuujis-scifi-rts.note: Sci-fi RTS sheet, 10 x 6 cells of 256 px (128 pt at 2x): three factions (iron, brood, lumen) x ten unit/building roles, then map pieces and command/upgrade icons. sheet.json names every cell.

zuujis-ships.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-ships.note: Shooter sprites in 64x44 cells: ss_player (2 flame frames), ss_basic/zigzag/diver/tank enemies (face down), ss_boss_<red|orange|blue|green>, ss_shot_player/enemy, and side-scroller variants ss_player_r, ss_*_l.

zuujis-space.grade_note: Clean vector ships, bosses and explosions in one atlas.
zuujis-space.note: Space shooter art: atlas.webp + atlas.json (name -> [x, y, w, h, drawScale]: bosses, ships, drones, rocks, drills, explosion frames boom0-9, crystals, pickups, shots, Cosmos Blaster logo), nebula-a/b (white-on-alpha clouds, tint them), rock.webp (seamless grey rock tile, tint it), planets.webp (five 512 px planets in a row).

zuujis-space-sfx.note: 25 synthesized space-shooter sounds (MP3, mono 44.1 kHz): shot, laser, blaser, missile, eshot, hit, pop, thud, wall, explode0-2, bigexplode, capsule, powerup, shield, oneup, die, start, warning, clear, error, over, best, select.

zuujis-sudoku.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-sudoku.note: Sudoku cell backgrounds, 30x30: sd_cell, sd_group, sd_same, sd_conflict, sd_sel.

zuujis-tiles.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-tiles.note: 16x16 terrain: grass/dirt/sand/snow/water/lava/stone/wood grounds, 16-way autotiles path_*/shore_*/road_* (suffix = connected neighbours in N E S W order, x = none), props (trees, rocks, fences, crates...), tower-defence slot/portal/keep/spawn_cave.

zuujis-towers.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.

zuujis-ui.grade_note: Generated 16 px DB16 pixel sheet: consistent but basic.
zuujis-ui.note: 8x8 cells. Panels/buttons/slots are 9 frames = the 3x3 slices of a 9-slice; bars are [left cap, middle, right cap]. Draw with GameAssets.ui().
